_about: [ORCH-OPEX-PREFIRE-1] D-S7CORE33-20 (Codex v2-57). The paths prefire's A13 (OPX-2) and A14 (OPX-3) look for in a brief's ALLOWED FILES section. Data, not code: edit here, no code change. Keys under each list are the `#!queue … repo=` name; '*' applies to every repo; a brief with no repo= is judged against every list. Globs, matched case-insensitively against each path the section names: '**/' any directories (or none), a trailing '/**' the directory itself and everything under it, '*' within one name, '?' one character. A pattern without '/' matches any one name in the path (a file or a directory). A path matches when it, or a directory it sits under, matches; a glob in ALLOWED FILES matches when it reaches into the pattern's tree. Keys starting with '_' are notes.

agent_runtime._about: A13 (OPX-2): code an agent runs on. A brief naming one cites an Agent Policy id (AP-…) listed in the latest SCP_Agent_Inventory_v*.md in the canon folder.
agent_runtime._orchestrator: orchestrator.py is the whole file: the fire path (fire_toni) cannot be told apart from the rest of it by file name.

protected._about: A14 (OPX-3): never-autonomous paths. A brief naming one carries a George go (`## George go:` line, or a `## Briefs:` / `## Spec reference:` line matching George[^\n]{0,80}\b(go|GO|agreed|Agree)\b).
protected._*: Secrets (*.env*) and deploy / IaC files, in every repo.
protected._clinical-mp: CDS rules, clinical logic, FHIR mappings, PROs scoring, auth / AccessPolicy / ClientApplication code, migrations.
protected._orchestrator: orchestrator.py holds the merge code (merge_branch, run_batch's merge).
